content:
**Traveling Pharmacy** is a Strength-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Reduces the weight of chems, such as Buffout, Med-X, and Psycho. Also reduces the weight of (diluted) RadAway, (diluted) stimpaks, (glowing) blood packs, disease cures, and antibiotics.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★ | 2 | Weights of all Chems (including Stimpaks) are reduced by 90%. | 0010BCB0 | 
| ★ | 1 | Weights of all Chems (including Stimpaks) are reduced by 45%. | 0010BCAC |
